propositions: prev_snapshot.json currently stores full ACLI payloads at 228.1 MB total / 4.5 MB per day; narrowing to a dict of {jira_key: {}} reduces HEAD payload from 27.1 MB to 19,960 bytes

With key-set prev, consecutive snapshot pairs with identical key-sets become byte-identical and produce no commit; measured over 400 real revisions, 218 of 399 pairs had identical key-sets with mean symmetric difference of 1.78 keys when changed

The existing call-site filter drop_snapshot_differ_local_state_emissions prevents field-bearing mutations from reaching Jira dispatch for both full-payload and key-set prev shapes; corpus mutation-diff over 4 real pairs showed zero observable difference

Key-set prev eliminates 973-998 wasted (outbound, create, unbound_local) mutations per pass when fetch window shrinks or project is re-targeted, reducing differ work without changing Jira-facing behavior

prev-shape-sensitive consumers check_dual_identity_complete and differ local-only/emit-both arms require dict entries for `local_state[key] or {}` guard pattern; shape constraint mandates dict not set

Rollback requires corpus forward (full→key-set) and backward (key-set→full) comparison; deleting prev_snapshot.json is unsafe as empty prev causes re-derived inbound creates unless suppressed by rebar-id label
